_comment: Virtual-tour providers whose players may be framed on project pages. Single source of truth: next.config.mjs adds these to the CSP frame-src, and lib/media-embed.ts only embeds a tour whose host matches (anything else falls back to an outbound link). Every host here was checked to serve without X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors restrictions. CSP wildcard *.example.com covers nested subdomains too.
